entries.title: Psalms 107:1
segments: ¶Oh, give thanks to the LORD, for [He is] good! For His mercy [endures] forever.

entries.title: Psalms 107:2
segments: Let the redeemed of the LORD say [so], Whom He has redeemed from the hand of the enemy,

entries.title: Psalms 107:3
segments: And gathered out of the lands, From the east and from the west, From the north and from the south.

entries.title: Psalms 107:4
segments: They wandered in the wilderness in a desolate way; They found no city to dwell in.

entries.title: Psalms 107:5
segments: Hungry and thirsty, Their soul fainted in them.

entries.title: Psalms 107:6
segments: Then they cried out to the LORD in their trouble, [And] He delivered them out of their distresses.

entries.title: Psalms 107:7
segments: And He led them forth by the right way, That they might go to a city for a dwelling place.

entries.title: Psalms 107:8
segments: Oh, that [men] would give thanks to the LORD [for] His goodness, And [for] His wonderful works to the children of men!

entries.title: Psalms 107:9
segments: For He satisfies the longing soul, And fills the hungry soul with goodness.

entries.title: Psalms 107:10
segments: ¶Those who sat in darkness and in the shadow of death, Bound in affliction and irons-

entries.title: Psalms 107:11
segments: Because they rebelled against the words of God, And despised the counsel of the Most High,

entries.title: Psalms 107:12
segments: Therefore He brought down their heart with labor; They fell down, and [there was] none to help.

entries.title: Psalms 107:13
segments: Then they cried out to the LORD in their trouble, [And] He saved them out of their distresses.

entries.title: Psalms 107:14
segments: He brought them out of darkness and the shadow of death, And broke their chains in pieces.

entries.title: Psalms 107:15
segments: Oh, that [men] would give thanks to the LORD [for] His goodness, And [for] His wonderful works to the children of men!

entries.title: Psalms 107:16
segments: For He has broken the gates of bronze, And cut the bars of iron in two.

entries.title: Psalms 107:17
segments: ¶Fools, because of their transgression, And because of their iniquities, were afflicted.

entries.title: Psalms 107:18
segments: Their soul abhorred all manner of food, And they drew near to the gates of death.

entries.title: Psalms 107:19
segments: Then they cried out to the LORD in their trouble, [And] He saved them out of their distresses.

entries.title: Psalms 107:20
segments: He sent His word and healed them, And delivered [them] from their destructions.

entries.title: Psalms 107:21
segments: Oh, that [men] would give thanks to the LORD [for] His goodness, And [for] His wonderful works to the children of men!

entries.title: Psalms 107:22
segments: Let them sacrifice the sacrifices of thanksgiving, And declare His works with rejoicing.

entries.title: Psalms 107:23
segments: ¶Those who go down to the sea in ships, Who do business on great waters,

entries.title: Psalms 107:24
segments: They see the works of the LORD, And His wonders in the deep.

entries.title: Psalms 107:25
segments: For He commands and raises the stormy wind, Which lifts up the waves of the sea.

entries.title: Psalms 107:26
segments: They mount up to the heavens, They go down again to the depths; Their soul melts because of trouble.

entries.title: Psalms 107:27
segments: They reel to and fro, and stagger like a drunken man, And are at their wits' end.

entries.title: Psalms 107:28
segments: Then they cry out to the LORD in their trouble, And He brings them out of their distresses.

entries.title: Psalms 107:29
segments: He calms the storm, So that its waves are still.

entries.title: Psalms 107:30
segments: Then they are glad because they are quiet; So He guides them to their desired haven.

entries.title: Psalms 107:31
segments: Oh, that [men] would give thanks to the LORD [for] His goodness, And [for] His wonderful works to the children of men!

entries.title: Psalms 107:32
segments: Let them exalt Him also in the assembly of the people, And praise Him in the company of the elders.

entries.title: Psalms 107:33
segments: ¶He turns rivers into a wilderness, And the watersprings into dry ground;

entries.title: Psalms 107:34
segments: A fruitful land into barrenness, For the wickedness of those who dwell in it.

entries.title: Psalms 107:35
segments: He turns a wilderness into pools of water, And dry land into watersprings.

entries.title: Psalms 107:36
segments: There He makes the hungry dwell, That they may establish a city for a dwelling place,

entries.title: Psalms 107:37
segments: And sow fields and plant vineyards, That they may yield a fruitful harvest.

entries.title: Psalms 107:38
segments: He also blesses them, and they multiply greatly; And He does not let their cattle decrease.

entries.title: Psalms 107:39
segments: When they are diminished and brought low Through oppression, affliction and sorrow,

entries.title: Psalms 107:40
segments: He pours contempt on princes, And causes them to wander in the wilderness [where there is] no way;

entries.title: Psalms 107:41
segments: Yet He sets the poor on high, far from affliction, And makes [their] families like a flock.

entries.title: Psalms 107:42
segments: The righteous see [it] and rejoice, And all iniquity stops its mouth.

entries.title: Psalms 107:43
segments: Whoever [is] wise will observe these [things], And they will understand the lovingkindness of the LORD.
